card.title: I Made the Exception
card.instruction: Treat every exception you once arranged as an unpaid obligation. Casually expect cooperation whenever the old favor becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Since I waived your joining fee, I'd like you to nominate me for treasurer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you back the fee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You repaid money. I made you an exception.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already nominated Ruth. She asked first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ask her to nominate me. You can use your favor with her to settle yours with me.
